notes:
What's new in 0.1.109:
- Users and the Dashboard: totals and the session list now agree for older or imported history rows (a 2-minute session no longer shows 0m). Display only; no stored history was changed.
- Live TV: a short network drop no longer leaves a dim "Reconnecting" overlay over healthy video. The favourite star changes only after the save succeeds, with an error message if it fails. Tuning a channel gives up with a message instead of waiting forever.
- Movie Night: the paused reveal button now reads Resume or Pause correctly. Kitchen announcements keeps an unsent draft if sending fails.
- Edit info (Metadata editor): field errors are announced to screen readers, focus returns to the right place after the artwork picker closes, and Escape closes a subpanel first.
- Away from home and the converter: starting or switching video quality can no longer let a late older conversion close the newer one, and a paused film resumes as before. The browser player uses Beebo's own HLS code only on desktop Chromium and Edge; phones, tablets, TVs and Apple browsers keep the built-in player.
- Browser music page: new Repeat and Queue controls. Settings search finds more settings and links to the Music, Playlists, Podcasts, Radio and Users pages.
- Picture Frame, Library Health and Jellyfin-compatible mode: small fixes (a cleared photo request cannot show late; missing-poster findings carry the title's id; age rating and running time are passed to Jellyfin apps).
- Not fixed: changing video quality while a film plays can still restart the converter in some cases. A TV linked through a member sign-in can still get the owner's photo powers, and the wake-up information (a network address) can still be seen by a media-only session. Chromecast items are still being tested. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not in this release.
- Not yet checked: automated tests and code review only; not tried on a real PC yet.
- Release source commit 826a3931d.
